context: Private formative challenge for mixed software developers, followed by separate named-role validation. Candidate task-local semantics only.
goal: Prepare the current candidate meanings for the engineer-assessment research product and MVP software.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A permission entry is an application enforcement rule, not a Lab Authority claim or owner decision.
Role membership alone does not satisfy purpose, object or separation-of-duties guards.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One MVP policy version, action and resource class.
working_meaning.statement: An Application Access Permission is one versioned allow rule for an authenticated principal with an active role assignment to attempt a named action on a resource under exact subject, purpose, state and decision guards, with default denial otherwise.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: A policy file does not activate itself or grant governance authority.
Changing a permission or guard creates a successor version with review and test evidence.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One challenge deployment and policy version.
working_meaning.statement: An Application Access Policy is an immutable versioned set of Access Permissions, default-deny rules, separation-of-duties constraints and evaluation order selected for one deployment and protocol scope.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: An allow receipt is not scientific evidence or owner authority.
A logged intent or denied attempt is not proof that a downstream operation completed.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.statement: An Access Decision Receipt is an attributable result of evaluating one principal, action, resource, purpose and state against one Access Policy version and active role assignment, recording allow or deny, guard reasons and time without answer content.

payload.applicability: Candidate assessment and MVP design only; semantic owner review required before operational use.

boundaries: It cannot authorize employer sharing, bulk export or a new processing purpose.
An incident label alone does not create this grant or override normal access checks.
working_meaning.ownership_posture: Task-local proposed meaning; semantic owner principal unassigned.
working_meaning.scope: One exceptional access ticket and exact protected objects.
working_meaning.statement: An Exceptional Access Grant is a short-lived, object- and operation-specific application grant for a documented rights, evidence or incident case, with separate owner approvals, expiry, purpose and use receipts.

originating_intent: Define every critical assessment and MVP software concept before implementation and participant collection.
